archimate:Outcome.name: Complete Continuity of Care Bundle delivered at Every Transition and Reduced Readmissions and Adverse Events
archimate:Outcome.documentation:
The "Complete Continuity of Care Bundle delivered at Every Transition and Reduced Readmissions and Adverse Events" goal is a clinical quality metric focused on providing a standardized package of post-discharge interventions whenever a patient moves between care settings while simultaneously lowering the rates of hospital returns and medical complications.
Its purpose is to eliminate gaps in communication and treatment during patient handoffs, ensuring that clinical oversight remains seamless to protect patient safety and control healthcare costs.
Example: A hospital achieves this goal by automatically executing a checklist that includes a 48-hour follow-up call, a synchronized medication list, and an expedited primary care appointment for every discharged heart failure patient, resulting in a 15% drop in their 30-day return rate.
